verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that lets users operate with natural language through their chosen LLM client. That is a first-party natural-language path, but the evidence never shows which risk-management operations it exposes, such as risk profiles, rules, lists or case review. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server covers Risk Management functions specifically, documentation of supported natural-language actions and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
